summary: native-frontend-orb ships obfuscated preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a CircleCI orb aggregator (YAML CI configuration), but ships a `preinstall` script (`setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from oven-sh's GitHub releases, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods it executable (0o755), and then invokes it via `execFileSync` against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727 KB heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle shipped in the tarball. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are obfuscated: `setup.mjs` uses hex-prefixed identifier scrambling (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and string-table indirection to hide its fs/https imports, and `math_init.js` uses an obfuscator.io-style rotated string array with a `WV8StW` shuffle function. A CircleCI orb definition (YAML aggregation) has no legitimate need for a second JavaScript runtime or an obfuscated 727 KB bundle at install time; downloading Bun specifically to execute the bundle bypasses Node-based inspection and sandboxing of the payload. The package's `repository` field points at `ornikar/orb-frontend-native`, consistent with impersonation of Ornikar's internal mobile CI orb. Installing this package auto-executes the concealed payload under the fetched runtime.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
